title: THE DIVE
prompt:
6 seconds, 16:9. ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, NO CUTS. A parallel side-on tracking shot that moves left to right with THE MOUNT and follows it down under the surface; the camera stays level the whole time, no tilt, no cut.

THE DIVE. THE MOUNT carries THE THREE RIDERS from the surface down into the sea, travelling left to right.

REFERENCES, each with a job:
@Image 1: THE MOUNT. Take nothing of the white background.
@Image 2: THE STRONG ONE. Face, body and colours only; take nothing of the white background.
@Image 3: THE YOUNG ONE. Face, body and colours only; take nothing of the white background.
@Image 4: THE ELDER. Face, body and colours only; take nothing of the white background.
@Image 5: THE OPEN SEA. Take its look exactly.

THE FRAME: Side on and level, THE MOUNT moving from the left of frame to the right; first half above the waterline, then below it, the camera sinking with it and staying level.

PARTICLES: a burst of silver bubbles as they go under, small bubbles rising, drifting specks in the water, shafts of light from the surface.

EACH CHARACTER, ALL THROUGH THE SHOT (each busy with their own action, never all the same):
- THE STRONG ONE, front perch: looks back at the other two and lifts one fist, the signal to dive, then crouches low over the perch as they go under.
- THE YOUNG ONE, middle: sucks in a huge breath, cheeks puffed, grinning, and grabs the backrest; underwater the child's eyes go wide, looking all around.
- THE ELDER, back: nods at the signal, takes one slow calm breath and wraps an arm round the child; underwater his gill frills fan out and he points ahead.

WHAT HAPPENS:
[0s] On the surface, THE MOUNT glides from left to right. THE STRONG ONE looks back and lifts a fist; THE ELDER nods; THE YOUNG ONE sucks in a huge breath, cheeks puffed, gill frills flaring open.
[2s] THE MOUNT tips its wings and slides under the surface, still moving left to right; the camera follows it down, level, side on; THE STRONG ONE crouches low.
[4s] Underwater in clear blue water: THE YOUNG ONE's eyes go wide, looking all around; THE ELDER points ahead; THE MOUNT glides on to the right.

Sound: only the sounds the characters make themselves: THE THREE RIDERS' deep breath before the dive, THE YOUNG ONE's excited squeak as they go under, then silence underwater. No music, no ambient sound.

Colour grade, their daylight: bright blue-white, faint stars still visible in the bright sky, never orange, cool turquoise water, the neon-green grass as the one warm accent. Photographed, not rendered: fine film grain, gentle anamorphic softness at the edges.

Avoid: no dialogue, no camera tilt, no dutch angle, no movement right to left, no rider left behind.
